pumi.workflow.v1.PlanningOutput.NoTest.j.description:
NoTest is one requirement of the plan's change that the plan gives no
 test, with the reason (decision 0295).

^(requirement_id)$.description: The requirement's ID, such as BLS-001 (decision 0274).

reason.description: Why the requirement has no test, and how it is verified instead.

requirementId.description: The requirement's ID, such as BLS-001 (decision 0274).

pumi.workflow.v1.PlanningOutput.NoTest.j.title: No Test

id.description:
The id of the question, unique in the output, by which the second
 opinion answers it.

pumi.workflow.v1.PlanningOutput.jsonsche.description:
PlanningOutput is the structured output of the planning stage of the first
 workflow (decision 0171): the plan, the paths it will change, and any open
 questions, each with the agent's own answer. The questions.open fact is
 projected from it.

^(declared_paths)$.description:
The paths the plan will change, as patterns relative to the root of the
 repository. The scope gate reads the changed paths outside them
 (paths.outside, decision 0136).

^(no_test)$.description:
The requirements that the plan gives no test, each with the reason.
 The kernel adds the reasons to the coverage report before the
 conformance audit, which judges each of them (decision 0295).

declaredPaths.description:
The paths the plan will change, as patterns relative to the root of the
 repository. The scope gate reads the changed paths outside them
 (paths.outside, decision 0136).

noTest.description:
The requirements that the plan gives no test, each with the reason.
 The kernel adds the reasons to the coverage report before the
 conformance audit, which judges each of them (decision 0295).

questions.description:
The open questions. With none, the plan goes to plan review; with any,
 to a second opinion.

pumi.workflow.v1.PlanningOutput.jsonsche.title: Planning Output
